extraction_bugs_fixed_this_run: trailing '/' was being stripped from every extracted URL, silently 404-ing ~48 directory-style URLs that were actually fine (or masking 3 that were genuinely dead only without the slash) -- fixed by no longer stripping '/'
a JS string-concatenation fragment ('...Line/si_' + name + '.svg' in Games/real-middle-india.html) was captured as a literal URL -- excluded
a hardcoded skill.icon template literal (dojos.html, '${skill.icon}') was captured as a literal URL -- excluded via a '${' filter

trailing ')' was being stripped unconditionally, corrupting 2 URLs whose real path legitimately ends in a parenthesis (Wikipedia article titles, a WHO fact-sheet slug) -- fixed to only strip an unbalanced trailing ')'

<link rel=preconnect/dns-prefetch/preload> resource hints (bare-origin hrefs like https://fonts.googleapis.com, the Supabase project origin) were being extracted and checked as if they were content links -- excluded, since a bare-origin GET 404 there says nothing about link rot

description: Weekly external-link-rot routine state. Tracks every external http(s) href across tracked HTML (excludes Backups/, node_modules/, tests/, supabase/email-templates/), rotates through the full set at ~400 checks/run via `cursor` (an index into the sorted URL list), and re-checks any URL currently marked dead/dead-pending every run so a fix or a further-confirmed death both surface promptly. Full URL list is NOT stored here (regenerated fresh each run from the repo); only per-URL check history is kept, keyed by the exact href string as it appears in source (including trailing slash -- do not strip it, see 2026-08-27 note).
